help.http_requests_total: Total HTTP requests by method, path group, and status code.
help.tasks_by_stage: Number of tasks per board and stage.
help.tasks_by_type: Number of tasks per board and task type (empty type = untyped).
help.agent_runs_total: Total agent runs by agent type and stop reason.
help.tokens_consumed_total: Total LLM tokens consumed by model and token type.
help.cost_usd_total: Total estimated cost in USD by model.
help.env_metrics_polls_total: Cloud metric collection passes per environment, by result (ok, fail).
help.auth_events_total: Authentication events by kind (register, refresh, logout, sso).
help.event_hub_streams: Open multiplexed event streams (one per browser tab).
help.event_hub_sources: Running event sources (chat bus bridges, log tails).
help.event_hub_subscriptions: Topic subscriptions across all open streams.
